claim_or_question: Public is not the same as commons
description: Making something public does not guarantee maintenance, review, correction, stewardship, or use.
A visible or filled-out template is not equivalent to structurally reviewable validity.

claim_or_question: Podcast archives can become living artifacts
description: High-signal conversations can become source-linked, review-aware, searchable field memory.

claim_or_question: Podcast claims are not verified knowledge
description: Guest statements require context, source lineage, and review before public guidance.

claim_or_question: Public goods builders often rebuild without enough shared context
description: Existing tools, repos, standards, and retrospectives are difficult to discover before building.
evidence_needed: Needs builder interviews / grant review evidence

claim_or_question: Social signals are routing aids, not endorsements
description: Mentions and retweets can expand the review universe but should not imply quality.

claim_or_question: Open-source publication is not maintained public goods infrastructure
description: A public repo may not be documented, maintained, secure, or reusable.

claim_or_question: Source systems are not extractable link pools
description: Living knowledge environments carry worldview, stewardship, attribution, and return-path needs.
